faq.q: Does "Langley" on this page mean Langley City or the Township?
faq.a: Both. The SnapStats community Langley combines the Township of Langley and the City of Langley across eleven sub-areas, and the live feed's cards span Township sub-areas such as Willoughby Heights, Brookswood and Aldergrove as well as the Langley City sub-area (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR September 2026 report).

No — the feed's visible cards include detached houses, a strata unit and manufactured homes in an Aldergrove 55+ park, alongside the detached stock. Buyers who want detached only should filter by type in the feed; this file's market figures keep detached and attached separate for the same reason.

faq.q: What transit serves Langley buyers in this band now, and what is coming?
faq.a: Now: bus routes including the 501 (Surrey Central to Langley Centre via Fraser Highway and 200 Street), the 372 and the 595 to Maple Ridge via the Golden Ears Bridge, with the Carvolth Exchange at 200 Street and Highway 1 as a hub. Coming: TransLink states the Surrey-Langley SkyTrain extension will run 16 km along Fraser Highway from King George Station to 203 Street in Langley City, with an anticipated in-service date of 2029.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in Langley?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Langley?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.
